title: [NatWest demo] Chaos injection outside change window
description: Detects chaos-audit events (nwpay:chaos action=inject) landing OUTSIDE the published change window (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 UTC). Demonstrates the SOC-style discipline of treating any production-touching action outside the agreed change window as a SIEM-grade signal, even when the actor is a legitimate operator. Fires one ITSI notable per inject so the platform team can verify it was an approved exception (a 'normal' inject inside the window does not fire). The actor and scenario travel on the notable event so Episode Review has the context to triage without re-running the search.
search: index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:chaos" action="inject" | eval hour = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")), wday = tonumber(strftime(_time, "%w")) | where (wday < 1 OR wday > 5) OR (hour < 9 OR hour >= 17) | eval severity = "5" | eval service = "NatWest Card Payments" | eval title = "Off-window chaos injection: " . scenario . " on " . coalesce(target_service, "unknown") | eval source = "Splunk ES - chaos audit" | eval description = title . " by actor=" . coalesce(actor, "unknown") . " at " . strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") . ". Verify this was an approved change." | eval cohort_key = "chaos:" . coalesce(event_id, scenario . ":" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M")) | table _time, severity, service, title, source, scenario, target_service, actor, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
